title: Document Understanding Models
summary: This module encompasses models designed for document understanding tasks, leveraging both textual and visual information. It includes architectures capable of extracting features from documents and generating text based on their content and layout.

nodes.label: Document Input
nodes.title: Raw Document Data
nodes.description: The initial input consisting of document images and associated text with bounding box coordinates, typically pre-processed by an OCR engine.

nodes.label: UDOP Model
nodes.title: Encoder-Decoder for Documents
nodes.description: A comprehensive encoder-decoder model designed for document understanding, capable of processing both text and visual information to generate structured or free-form text outputs.

nodes.label: UDOP Encoder Model
nodes.title: Document Feature Extractor
nodes.description: The encoder-only variant of UDOP, focused on extracting rich, multimodal features from documents for various downstream analytical tasks.

nodes.label: Generated Text
nodes.title: Text Output
nodes.description: The textual output produced by the UDOP Model's decoder, such as answers to questions, summaries, or extracted entities.

nodes.label: Document Features
nodes.title: Extracted Features
nodes.description: The numerical representations of the document's content and structure, derived from the encoder, useful for classification, retrieval, or other analytical tasks.

groups.label: Input Source
groups.title: Document Data Input
groups.description: Represents the source of raw document data that feeds into the UDOP models.

groups.label: Core Models
groups.title: UDOP Architectures
groups.description: Contains the main UDOP model implementations, including the full encoder-decoder and the encoder-only variants.

groups.label: Output Sinks
groups.title: Model Outputs
groups.description: Represents the different types of outputs generated by the UDOP models.
